introHtml: Cork brings a natural, sustainable texture to drinkware and food accessories. Unlike plastic or metal, cork insulates without sweating, making it ideal for custom can coolers and bottle sleeves. Marketing directors and business owners choose cork to signal environmental responsibility while keeping drinks cold at trade shows or employee events. The Koozie® Cork Can Cooler, for example, combines classic insulation with a warm, tactile finish that stands out in any cooler or picnic setting.
